senses.gloss: m. pl. (used as sing., sub. שטר) (הרק, v. חֲרִיקָא) surety, esp. for royal taxes (כַּרְגָּא).
units: Yeb. 46ᵃ; B. Mets. 73ᵇ מוֹהַרְקַיְיהוּ דהני וכ׳ (Ms. M. מוהד׳) the surety for these people lies in the archive of the king, and the king has ordained that he who pays no charga can be made the servant of him who pays (for him).—[Erub. 62ᵃ בריאה במ׳ ואבורגני (Rabad פרהגבני, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60) a lease is sound if made legal by sureties and (countersigned) by officers. Oth. explan., v. אַבּוּרְגְּנָא.]
